text: Natasha - flying to Tokyo 2 November 2026, 14hr flight w/ connection in Doha. dreading it. ask how jetlag was the week after
Fern's housewarming Sat 7th. new flat in Leith. bring wine not flowers - she's got hayfever
Tobi - mum in hosp again, hip. he's going up to Leeds the day before her op. text him that morning
Gabriel & Lena back from Lisbon. Lena got food poisoning 2nd night, rest was great

Noah & his partner Kieran just back from 2 wks in Vietnam. Noah's still jetlagged. Kieran wants to go back already. Hoi An was the highlight apparently, they did a cooking class and he's now obsessed w/ making pho at home. Noah's sister Zoe watched their dog Rolo while they were away and apparently he's put on weight. they're having ppl round for a Vietnamese dinner 15 Nov to show the photos. I'm invited, bring beer
Kaito invited me to his 40th - dinner @ Dishoom, 14 Nov. said yes
James's brother Noah moving to Melbourne March 2027. James gutted tbh
Divya - sister Ana getting married in Goa Jan 2027. whole fam flying out the week before. Divya stressing re outfits
remind me to ask Noor how the Peru trip went. back Thurs

Call w/ Divya re her parents' 40th anniv. big do planned - dinner at the Taj, 13 March 2027, 80 guests. her brother Nikhil flying in from Toronto the week before to help. Divya's doing the slideshow, wants old photos from everyone. her mum doesn't know about the surprise part (renewing vows). Divya very stressed, also juggling work deadline that same week. remind me to dig out the uni photos & send by end of Jan
Carlos / dog Biscuit had op on his paw yest. ok now, wobbly. Carlos v relieved
dinner @ Anil & Beatriz's off - kids both got norovirus. rescheduling to Dec sometime
Aneesh - wife Gemma expecting! due April 2027. first one. don't forget card
Irina said Krisztina (her daughter) starts uni in Bristol in Sept. Irina already sad about empty nest

Kaito Chen - just back from honeymoon in Peru w/ Ana. Machu Picchu trek, 4 days. Ana got altitude sickness day 2, had to rest the next day but finished it. flights back were awful - lost luggage in Madrid, turned up 3 days later. they're doing a dinner for both families 1st Sat in Dec. Ana's mum still upset they eloped. ask Kaito how that dinner goes afterwards
Blessing's leaving do - Fri, Brewdog. I'm doing the collection
Yetunde & Milan hosting Christmas this yr - 14 ppl. Yetunde says her mum's coming from Lagos a week before
Alfie - got into the Rome exchange! leaves Feb 2027. congrats msg
Dana's dad had a fall last wk. she's driving down to Kent most weekends now. check in w/ her Sun

Gemma - her brother James got the Sydney job. leaves 2 Jan 2027, 2-yr contract. her mum's devastated, been crying all wk. James's farewell party is the Sat before he goes, at their mum's. Gemma asked if I can help w/ decorations that morning. said yes. also he's mad about cricket so maybe an Aussie Test ticket as leaving gift? check prices
Suzanne: vegan now, no exceptions. for the dinner on 23rd
passport renewal - expires June 2027. need it done before Easter
Nikhil's engagement party 30 November 2026, his parents' place in Leicester. need to sort train + gift. he mentioned they want a nice coffee grinder

Lena - stag/hen planning. her sister Irina's hen in Prague, 6-8 March 2027. 12 of them. Lena's maid of honour, sorting everything. budget a nightmare, 2 ppl dropped out. flights booked from Stansted that Fri morning, back the Sun evening. dress code pink. she asked me to make the playlist. wedding itself May 2027 in Cornwall
Kieran - mum Teresa's 70th, surprise party Sat 15th. he wants me to keep her busy that afternoon. she thinks we're going for lunch
call w/ Natasha (Tash) - she & her partner booked Bali for May 2027. 2 wks. first proper hol in 4 yrs
Fern - nervous re her brother Sam's wedding speech, Oct 31. ring her afterwards to see how it went
Tobi's sister Divya had baby girl!! 3 Oct. named her Amara. send something
Carlos - dinner party @ his 12 Dec, ugly jumper theme. bring dessert. his husband does mains

Blessing's dad Uncle Femi - 60th in Lagos, 2 Feb 2027. Blessing flying out a week before, staying till the 10th. her mum wants everyone in matching aso ebi. Blessing's nervous about the long flight w/ the baby (8 months). told her to get bassinet seat. text her the day before she flies
Kaito - kids Hana & Ren start new school after half term. move to Manchester went fine. ask how first wk went
James Murphy - wedding anniv next wk (10 yrs). taking wife to Paris, Eurostar Fri morning. might ask for Bistro recs - send Lena's list
pick up dry cleaning, buy suncream + adaptors before flight
Noor - into pottery, does a class Weds. wants a wheel of her own eventually. bday Feb - gift idea?

Suzanne & Teresa housewarming last Sat. house in Didsbury - huge garden, they're getting chickens. Teresa's dad built them a pergola. her mum brought way too much food. great night. Suzanne mentioned she's starting a pottery course in Jan and Teresa's training for London marathon April 2027. Teresa was limping a bit - shin splints
Beatriz's mum diagnosed w/ diabetes. Beatriz flying to São Paulo 4 December 2026 for 3 wks. she's struggling. message her the day after she lands
Irina & husband Milan cancelled Iceland trip - his back's playing up. physio Mon
Aneesh's dad retiring end of Nov after 35 yrs at the council. party at their house the wk after. Aneesh writing a speech

Aneesh - long chat. his partner Zoe's been offered a post-doc in Boston, starts Sept 2027. they're thinking of moving together, he'd need a visa. his parents not thrilled. they're going out for a recce trip at Easter. he's anxious re leaving his job at the hospital. ring him in a couple of wks to see where they've landed
Blessing Okafor - moving to Dubai for work, Jan 2027. flat viewing over video tmrw. leaving party TBC
Gemma - cat Pickle went missing Sun. found Mon morning in neighbour's shed. lol
Zoe's 30th - flying to Barcelona w/ the girls 21-24 March 2027. I'm in. need to book flights before prices go up
Krisztina - housewarming was lovely. her partner Jonah cooked goulash. must send thank you + the photos

Milan - 3 wk trip to Japan & Korea booked for April 2027. Tokyo, Kyoto, Seoul. his wife Dana & their kids Alfie (9) and Fern (6). first long haul for the kids. Dana worried about the 13hr flight. Milan wants ramen recs - send him the list from Kaito. they fly out the morning after school breaks up

Kieran's brother in hosp after bike crash Sat. broken collarbone. surgery Thurs. Kieran's mum flying back from Spain the day before. Kieran sounded wrecked. text him Thurs eve after op, maybe drop food round the next day
gym Mon/Wed/Fri this month. no excuses
Suzanne - daughter's christening 9 Nov, St Mary's then lunch after. I'm godmother!! need to get a gift - silver bracelet?
Nikhil - off to Japan for 3 wks w/ his dad. first time his dad's flown since the stroke. nikhil a bit worried. ask how it went when back
don't forget Lena's dinner Fri - 7.30, she's doing paella. bring the good olive oil

Fri catch up w/ Natasha & Carlos. Carlos's mum just moved in w/ them after his dad died in the summer. it's been hard. Natasha's taking a few wks off work. their twins start reception Sept 2027 - already stressing about school places. invited me for Sunday lunch next month
Divya Shah - brother Anil passed driving test (4th go!). family dinner after to celebrate
housewarming for me & G - Sat 29 November 2026? invites out by end of wk. sort food + more chairs
Fern/Gabriel - split up. the Greece trip they'd booked for spring is off. Fern keeping the flat. check in w/ her next wk
Tobi - flight to Lagos 20 Dec for his grandma's 90th. whole extended fam there. back 3 Jan. he's taking the kids, wife joining a few days after
Carlos said his mum loves orchids - for when we visit in Dec
Yetunde: new job @ Heathrow, starts Mon. first wk is nights. the morning after her first shift, text to see how it's going
Manon & Beatriz - both at Gemma's 40th on Sat. Beatriz bringing her new gf Teresa. lots of dancing. Gemma loved the cake
Jonah - interview w/ Emirates cabin crew 6 Nov. been practising. remind me to ask Jonah how it went the day after
Irina - mum's 80th lunch was cancelled, mum not well. Irina going up to Aberdeen this wkend instead
Alfie - fave band is Fontaines DC. they're touring spring 2027. tickets as bday present?? he hinted hard
